review_scope: Pinned source/AST only: admission gates, input provenance, resource and algorithm structure, one-shot failure and publication lifecycle. Parent independently owns association semantic proof and synthetic test design.
AST_syntax: PASS both Python modules parsed without import or target execution

admission_and_once_checks.preliminary_before_marker: Canonical regular scope + exact SHA + family/schema + matcher source SHA; minimal metadata only.
admission_and_once_checks.persistent_attempt: Exclusive openx marker; content flush/fsync and parent directory fsync before owner guards/full contract and before NumPy import. Same durable once-marker pattern in metadata generator.

owner_guards.source_contract: Existing canonical regular inodes only; O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW; exclusive nonblocking flock; retained through final input readback and receipt; inode/dev rechecked. Source-only review did not independently probe live lock files.
owner_guards.change_from_interim: Unused parent-level analysis/new_visit_recovery/ACTIVE_FAMILY_FLOCK.lock removed; actual results-level recovery family guard retained.

admission_and_once_checks.own_serial_gate: O_NOFOLLOW stable regular inode, exclusive nonblocking flock; held through terminal publication and never unlinked.
admission_and_once_checks.admission: Exact pinned ROOT schema/status with all five true booleans, both verified RAW/RESULT durable proof classes, map_count762, source/workspace identity, ordered762map-pin digest and fixed-order four execution/two QA pins. Live relevant command paths also checked; root retains lifecycle/registry/durable-service truth responsibility.
admission_and_once_checks.scientific_import_gate: Single NumPy import inside main after durable marker, all owner guards, full contract, disk/free-space gate, own serial gate, fresh output mkdir and INPUT_PINS. Generator has no NumPy/H5 imports or decoding calls.
admission_and_once_checks.retry_resume: Existing marker or output rejects another attempt; no retry/resume path; direction checkpoints explicitly nonresumable; partial outputs and failure receipt preserved.

input_contract_checks.original_provenance: Generator authenticates exact known source/scope/driver and QA-code bytes, both original freezes, four COMPLETE receipts and two QA PASS receipts. QA scope/driver/script/freeze joins + exact corresponding execution receipt SHA are required; checkpoint/map/normalization bytes must match actual QA inventory. Admission additionally binds all six exact execution/QA pins in fixed order.
input_contract_checks.inventory: All762 unique ON/q entries ordered ON1/ON2/ON3 thenq1..254; originalq128 included once; source intervals/carriers4096/hypotheses1570 validated. q0/q255 and other source/holdout data excluded.
input_contract_checks.normalization: 759 separate existing bulk normalization JSON pins; three q128 embedded normalization records covered by existing checkpoint pin. No normalization recomputation/application by matcher.
input_contract_checks.array_contract_future_execution: Seven exact NPZ array keys; allow_pickle=False; exact little-endian dtype and CORE4096/GRID785 shapes; score/drift finite; widths1/3; validcount1570; int64 source-channel vector/frequency exact; grids byte-identical and every winning drift roundtrips byte-exactly to its original grid member.
input_contract_checks.same_read_bytes: Metadata parsed from the same raw bytes checked against expected SHA/size. Final readback covers scope/script/metadata/admission/durable-proof pins/all maps and all759 norms.
input_contract_checks.root_followups: No generated scope/admission/public matcher freeze/GO reviewed here; actual future artifacts and their exact pins still require root review before any matching execution.

resource_structure.CPU_accounting: start_cpu0.0 includes cumulative processCPU from interpreter start; OS softCPU120/hardCPU122 and per-phase measured checks; no performance benchmark done.
resource_structure.disk_admission: Canonical nonoverlapping roots, explicit containment of source/output/script/scope in roots, fresh treebyte count plus64MiB reservation under8GiB, freefilesystem≥64MiB; final output leaves64KiB terminal headroom and shared roots checked again.
resource_structure.memory_conclusion: Retained arrays≈115.1MiB; directed/triple/rank temporaries remain O(N). Static structure is compatible with1GiB; no claimed measured RSS PASS, and malformed archives can still fail the OS/shape gates.
resource_structure.complexity: O(N log N) sorting/search plus O(N) fixed candidate work, six directions; no Cartesian pair/triple construction.
resource_structure.publication_boundary: Full terminal JSON materialized/flush/fsync and cap-checked before exclusive hardlink publication. Requires0.1CPU/2wall headroom, then disarms alarm/softCPU signal. Headroom is not a filesystem-latency bound; receipt timing snapshot is before final serialization/publication. Separate full-command outer measurement remains necessary for an actual complete-command resource claim.

failure_terminal_checks.before_COMPLETE: Any recorded attempt validation/resource/memory/IO failure preserves partial data and writes INCOMPLETE_ONE_SHOT_MATCHING_NO_RETRY, unless OS kill prevents a failure receipt; absence of valid COMPLETE remains incomplete.
failure_terminal_checks.COMPLETE_publication: Fsynced prepared file + exclusive os.link, directory fsync, prepared-link removal+directoryfsync; no partial canonical COMPLETE serialization and no overwrite of an existing terminal.
failure_terminal_checks.post_COMPLETE: complete_committed/canonical terminal existence prevents a conflicting scientific FAILURE. BrokenPipe is suppressed; later publication/outercommand failures preserve terminal but require root to report command status honestly.
